ops.note: Root cause: fold's folder.apply returned an error for an op whose kind the folder did not handle, so a single add_anchor written onto a task ref by a version-skewed writer made the whole chain unfoldable. Fixed in 5733259 by giving run() a tolerant mode — read paths skip an inapplicable op and count it on SkippedOps; fold.Strict remains the write path. The fold cache was compounding it: put() refused to store a skipped-op snapshot but get() accepted any v1 entry, so a newer binary's complete fold was served to an older binary as SkippedOps=0. The entry now discriminates on the registered op-kind set. Shipped in v0.49.0; main CI green on tip 315194e (run 30400491523, success).
